errors.text_span: eine blaue Linie für Westdeutschland, eine dunkelblaue Linie für Gesamtdeutschland und eine hellblaue Linie für Ostdeutschland
errors.evidence: The color-to-region mapping is incorrect and ambiguous. According to the legend, 'West' corresponds to the light blue line, 'Gesamtdeutschland' to the dark blue line, and 'Ost' to the very light blue line. The description incorrectly calls the 'West' line 'blaue Linie' (blue line) and the 'Ost' line 'hellblaue Linie' (light blue line), which better describes the 'West' line.

errors.text_span: Die blaue Linie für Westdeutschland beginnt bei etwa 6,9 im Jahr 2011 und endet bei etwa 7,1 im Jahr 2024.
errors.evidence: The description assigns values belonging to the 'Gesamtdeutschland' line to the 'Westdeutschland' line. The actual 'Westdeutschland' line (the top line) starts at approximately 7.05 and ends at approximately 7.15. The values 6.9 and 7.1 correspond to the 'Gesamtdeutschland' line.
In the description of the line for 'Ostdeutschland', the end value is stated as approximately 7.0. However, the chart shows this line ending at approximately 6.9 in 2024.

errors.text_span: Alle drei Linien zeigen im Laufe der Jahre leichte Schwankungen.
errors.evidence: This statement is a significant over-generalization. The chart shows a distinct peak around 2019 followed by a sharp drop to a minimum in 2021 for all three lines, which is much more pronounced than a 'leichte Schwankung' (slight fluctuation).

The description fails to mention the prominent peak around 2019 and the sharp dip around 2021, which are key features of the trends shown in the chart. The prompt specifically asks to note any peaks or drops.
The description completely omits the presence of error bars at each data point. Error bars are a critical element of this scientific plot, indicating uncertainty or confidence intervals.
The description does not mention the marker shape (circles) or the line style (solid) for the data series, which was requested in the prompt.
